glosses.notes: A country's highest diplomatic representative in another country, often seen in embassy visits and official meetings.

examples.sentence: 外国大使结束大学演讲以后，没有立刻离开，而是在走廊里停了很久，耐心回答学生关于签证和文化交流的问题。
市政府接待那位大使的时候，特意把本地青年创业项目也安排进参观路线，希望双方以后能有更实际的合作。
新闻里说那位大使到当地的第二天，就先去看学校和工厂，因为他想早点了解普通人的真实生活。

example_translations.translation: After the foreign ambassador finished the university speech, he did not leave right away. Instead, he stayed in the hallway for a long time and patiently answered students' questions about visas and cultural exchange.
When the city government received the ambassador, it deliberately included local youth startup projects in the visit route, hoping the two sides could have more practical cooperation later.
The news said that on the ambassador's second day there, he first went to visit schools and factories because he wanted to understand ordinary people's real lives as early as possible.

glosses.notes: A highly respected master or top expert in an art, craft, or professional field.

examples.sentence: 这位修复古画的大师来博物馆给大家上课时，连平时最坐不住的学生都安静下来，只想看他怎样下第一笔。
年轻厨师第一次跟着大师进厨房，才明白一道看起来简单的汤，为什么要反复试味道到深夜。
记者采访那位设计大师时问他怎么想到这些东西，他却笑着说自己只是比别人更愿意多看身边的小地方。

example_translations.translation: When this master of restoring old paintings came to teach at the museum, even the students who usually could not sit still went quiet and just wanted to watch how he made the first stroke.
The first time the young chef followed a master into the kitchen, he finally understood why a soup that looked simple had to be tasted again and again late into the night.
When reporters interviewed that design master and asked how he thought of those things, he smiled and said he was simply more willing than other people to notice the small places around him.

glosses.notes: The region that includes Australia, New Zealand, and many Pacific islands.

examples.sentence: 地理老师讲到大洋洲的时候，没有先让大家背国家名字，而是先看地图，想一想那些海岛为什么跟海运关系那么紧。
公司准备把业务慢慢做到大洋洲，所以培训时专门加了一节介绍当地市场和文化习惯的内容。
她去大洋洲学习半年以后，回来最常说的不是风景，而是那边城市和海边生活离得特别近。

example_translations.translation: When the geography teacher got to Oceania, she did not first make everyone memorize country names. Instead, she had them look at the map and think about why those islands are so closely tied to sea transport.
The company was preparing to gradually expand its business into Oceania, so the training program specially added a section introducing the local market and cultural habits.
After spending half a year studying in Oceania, what she talked about most after coming back was not the scenery, but how closely city life there is tied to the sea.

glosses.notes: Used for a rough estimate or general picture when the exact details are not yet known.

examples.sentence: 负责人听完大家的意见以后，先把计划的大致方向记在板上，免得讨论了半天还是不知道要先做什么。
我虽然记不清他当时说的每一句话，可是谈话的大致内容还在，至少知道他为什么突然改主意。
医生看完检查结果后说病情大致稳定，不过最好还是再观察两天，别因为感觉好一点就马上出院。

example_translations.translation: After hearing everyone's opinions, the person in charge first wrote the general direction of the plan on the board, so they would not spend half the discussion still not knowing what to do first.
Although I cannot remember every sentence he said at the time, I still remember the rough content of the conversation, at least enough to know why he suddenly changed his mind.

After looking at the test results, the doctor said the condition was roughly stable, but it would still be best to observe for two more days and not leave the hospital just because things felt a little better.

glosses.notes: Describes someone looking stunned, absent-minded, or slow to react after surprise or shock.

examples.sentence: 听见主持人突然叫自己名字的时候，他先是呆了两秒，接着才想起手里的纸还没有打开。
孩子在店里看见会动的玩具以后，站在门口呆呆地看了很久，连母亲叫他回家都没听见。
那位新来的实习生一听到系统全部停了，整个人都呆住了，后来还是主管拍拍他肩膀，他才开始找原因。

example_translations.translation: When he heard the host suddenly call his name, he went blank for two seconds before remembering that the paper in his hand had not even been opened yet.
After the child saw a moving toy in the shop, he stood at the doorway staring blankly for a long time and did not even hear his mother calling him to go home.
As soon as the new intern heard that the whole system had gone down, he froze in shock. Only after the supervisor patted his shoulder did he start looking for the cause.

glosses.notes: A formal written verb used in patterns like pending review, pending confirmation, or waiting for something to be settled.

examples.sentence: 具体名单还待老师最后同意，所以大家先别急着在会后把这个消息告诉别人。
这份报告虽然已经写完，可是里面最重要的几个数字还有待再看，不然谁也不敢现在就交上去。
门口那批待寄的材料已经按城市分好，可是快递车临时晚到，大家只好把地址再检查一遍。

example_translations.translation: The final list is still awaiting the teacher's final approval, so everyone was told not to rush to tell other people the news after the meeting.
This report is written already, but the most important numbers in it still need another look, otherwise no one would dare hand it in right now.
The batch of materials waiting to be mailed at the door had already been sorted by city, but the courier truck arrived late, so everyone had to check the addresses one more time.

glosses.notes: The cost or price, often the negative price paid for a choice, mistake, or success.

examples.sentence: 他为了这次工作，几天晚上都没有睡觉，虽然事情做完了，但是身体累的代价也马上出来了。
有些店为了抢客人一味压低价格，最后付出的代价是服务跟不上，老顾客反而越来越少。
她当年决定一个人去外地发展，不是没有代价，只是后来证明那些辛苦换来的经验很值得。

example_translations.translation: For this job, he did not sleep for several nights. Although the work got finished, the cost of exhausting his body also showed up right away.
Some shops keep cutting prices just to grab customers, but the price they end up paying is that the service cannot keep up and old customers gradually become fewer.
When she decided years ago to develop her career alone in another city, it was not without a cost, but later it proved that the experience bought with that hardship was worth it.

glosses.notes: A bank loan, or the act of borrowing money through one for a house, business, or other major need.

examples.sentence: 这家小公司刚接到大订单，却因为手里的资金不够，只好拿着合同去银行申请短期贷款。
经理提醒第一次办住房贷款的年轻人，别只看每个月要还多少，还得想清楚自己能不能稳定很多年。
银行同意给他贷款以后，他没有马上把钱全花掉，而是先把最急的设备换了，再慢慢安排别的计划。

example_translations.translation: This small company had just received a big order, but because it lacked funds on hand, it had no choice but to take the contract to the bank and apply for a short-term loan.

The manager reminded young people applying for a housing loan for the first time not to look only at the monthly payment, but also to think clearly about whether they could stay financially stable for many years.
After the bank agreed to lend him money, he did not spend it all right away. Instead, he first replaced the most urgent equipment and then slowly arranged the rest of the plan.

glosses.notes: To handle something on someone else's behalf, or to represent a person, company, or product as an agent.

examples.sentence: 原来的店长休假一个月，所以总部先派她来代理这家分店的日常工作，连进货和安排人手都得她决定。
那位律师这次不只帮他准备材料，还正式代理他去和对方谈判，免得他一紧张就把重点说乱。

examples.meaning_en: to handle sales as an agent
examples.sentence: 公司原本自己卖票，后来改成让旅行社代理以后，外地客人买起来方便多了，咨询电话也少了很多。

example_translations.translation: The original store manager took a month off, so headquarters first sent her to act as agent for this branch's daily operations, including purchasing and staffing.
This time the lawyer not only helped him prepare the materials, but also formally represented him in negotiating with the other side so that he would not jumble the key points once he got nervous.

The company originally sold tickets by itself, but after it switched to letting travel agencies handle them as agents, customers from other places found it much easier to buy them and the number of inquiry calls dropped a lot.

glosses.notes: To lead a group somewhere or guide people through a task or situation.

examples.sentence: 导游带领大家走过老街的时候，没有只讲老房子和过去的事，还让我们看路边一直开的花。
新班长带领大家上台时，开始还有点紧，但是看到老师点头以后，后面说得自然多了。
医生赶到现场以后，先带领家属按顺序让出通道，再安排护士把最需要处理的病人送进去。

example_translations.translation: As the guide led everyone through the old street, he did not talk only about old houses and things from the past. He also had us look at the flowers blooming along the roadside.
When the new class monitor led everyone onto the stage, he was a little tense at first, but after seeing the teacher nod, he spoke more and more naturally.
After the doctor arrived at the scene, he first guided the family members to clear the passage in order, then arranged for the nurses to take in the patient who most urgently needed treatment.

glosses.notes: Can describe something uncomplicated or someone innocent, and it can also mean purely or merely in a limited sense.

examples.sentence: 她离开原来的工作，不是单纯因为工资低，而是觉得每天都在重复解释同样的问题，已经学不到东西了。
老人喜欢那个年轻人，不是因为他会说话，而是因为他很单纯，答应的事都会去做。
这次讨论如果单纯看成本，当然可以少做一些事，但是大家怕那样会把最重要的地方也一起减掉。

example_translations.translation: She did not leave her former job merely because the pay was low, but because she felt she was repeating the same explanations every day and no longer learning anything.
The old man liked that young person not because he could talk well, but because he was simple-hearted and would do the things he promised.
If this discussion looked purely at cost, they could of course do fewer things, but everyone feared that would also cut away the most important parts.

glosses.notes: Describes something repetitive, lacking variety, or visually or mentally dull.

examples.sentence: 这个房间的墙一直是一样的灰色，时间长了看着太单调，所以大家后来在上面加了几张学生的画。
他原来以为整理档案会很单调，但是开始做以后，才发现每一份东西后面都有故事。
旅行要是只剩下赶路和按计划去每个景点，再好的风景也会变得单调，所以他们每天都故意留一点空时间随便走走。

example_translations.translation: The walls in this room had always been the same gray. After a long time they looked too monotonous, so later everyone added a few student paintings on top of them.
He originally thought organizing files would be very dull, but after he actually started doing it, he found that every item had a story behind it.

If a trip is reduced to nothing but rushing and following the plan to each sight, even the best scenery becomes monotonous, so they deliberately left themselves a little free time each day just to wander around.

glosses.notes: To delay something, hold someone up, or make a person miss time or progress.

examples.sentence: 车站一直提醒大家，别把行李放在路中间，因为一旦耽误别人上车下车，小事也会马上变成大问题。
她中午本来想顺路去办事，但是前面的系统突然坏了，结果排了很久队，下午开会都被耽误了。
老师没有因为他病了几天就怪他，只是怕课程要是耽误太多，他后面复习会更难。

example_translations.translation: The station kept reminding everyone not to put luggage in the middle of the way, because once it delays other people getting on and off, a small matter can quickly become a big problem.
She had planned to stop and handle something at noon, but the system ahead suddenly broke down. She ended up waiting in line for a long time, and her afternoon meeting was delayed too.
The teacher did not blame him for being sick for a few days. She was only afraid that if the course was delayed too much, review later would be even harder for him.

glosses.notes: To feel worried or anxious about something that may go wrong or remain uncertain.

examples.sentence: 项目刚宣布调整的时候，大家最担忧的不是工作会不会更忙，而是原来答应客户的时间会不会守不住。
母亲说让孩子自己选专业，但是到报学校那天，她还是一直担忧自己说得不对。
游客少了以后，卖东西的人最担忧的不是今天卖了多少，而是以后这条街还有没有人来。

example_translations.translation: When the project adjustment was first announced, what everyone worried about most was not whether the work would get busier, but whether the timeline promised to the client could still be kept.
The mother said the child should choose the major alone, but when the day came to apply to schools, she still kept worrying that what she had said was wrong.
After the number of visitors dropped, what the people selling things worried about most was not how much they sold today, but whether anyone would come to this street later on.

glosses.notes: Protein, the nutrient the body uses to build and repair tissue and maintain strength.

examples.sentence: 医生说她想继续减肥也可以，但是每天吃的蛋白质一定要够，不然人就会没有力气。
食堂把新菜单贴出来时，边上还写了每份饭里有多少蛋白质，方便运动队的人来选。
父亲做饭时总提醒孩子，别只顾着吃甜的和辣的，长身体的时候蛋白质、蔬菜和主食都不能少。

example_translations.translation: The doctor said she could keep losing weight, but the protein she ate every day had to be enough, otherwise she would have no strength.
When the cafeteria posted the new menu, it also wrote beside it how much protein each meal contained, making it easier for people on the sports team to choose.
When cooking, the father always reminds the child not to focus only on sweet and spicy food. While growing, protein, vegetables, and staple foods are all necessary.

glosses.notes: Used for a person being born or for a new idea, product, institution, or project coming into existence.

examples.sentence: 这个小图书角的想法诞生在一个停电的晚上，当时大家坐在楼下说话，都觉得这里少一个能一起看书的地方。
新产品终于诞生了，但是大家回头看时，最难忘的不是那一天，而是一次一次改方案的时候。
她说自己想做纪录片的念头，诞生于大学最后一年去山区实习的时候，因为那次经历完全改变了她看问题的方式。

example_translations.translation: The idea for this little reading corner was born on a night when the power went out. Everyone was sitting downstairs talking and felt the place needed somewhere people could read together.
The new product was finally born, but when everyone looked back, what they remembered most was not that day, but the times they revised the plan again and again.

She said the idea of making documentaries was born when she went to intern in the mountains during her last year of university, because that experience completely changed the way she looked at problems.

glosses.notes: Right there at the scene, immediately and in front of the people present.

examples.sentence: 名字刚念出来，他先没有说话，然后就在大家面前当场掉了眼泪。
工作人员发现票有问题以后，没有先赶人走，而是当场去查记录，几分钟就把话说清了。
司机看到老人快要倒了，就把车停下，又当场请前面乘客帮忙。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the name was read out, he fell silent for a moment and then burst into tears on the spot in front of everyone.
After the staff found a problem with the ticket, they did not rush to drive the person away. Instead, they checked the records on the spot and cleared things up in a few minutes.
When the driver saw that the elderly passenger was about to fall, he stopped the vehicle and right there asked the passengers in front to help.

glosses.notes: Refers back to the earlier time when something first began, was first decided, or originally seemed a certain way.

examples.sentence: 她现在回头看，当初那个看起来有点冲动的决定其实救了自己，因为如果继续拖下去，问题只会越来越难收拾。
公司当初租这间办公室的时候，只觉得离地铁近很方便，没想到几年以后周围会慢慢发展成新的商业区。
朋友见他终于把店开起来，都说早知道你会成功，他却笑着提醒大家，当初连他自己也常常睡不着。

example_translations.translation: Looking back now, she feels that the decision that seemed a little impulsive at first actually saved her, because if she had kept dragging things out, the problem would only have become harder to fix.

When the company first rented this office, it only thought being close to the subway was convenient. It never expected the area around it to slowly grow into a new business district a few years later.
When friends saw that he had finally opened the shop, they all said they knew he would succeed. He smiled and reminded them that at first even he himself often could not sleep.

glosses.notes: Refers to the contemporary age or to people, art, ideas, and habits that belong to it.

examples.sentence: 把老画和当代作品放在一起，是想让大家看今天和过去有什么不同。
老师讲当代文学的时候，不急着先下定义，而是让学生比较几位作者怎样写城市、家庭和普通人的压力。
研究当代人怎么出门的人发现，包做得简单一点，大家用起来反而更方便。

example_translations.translation: Putting older paintings together with contemporary works is meant to let people see what is different between today and the past.

When the teacher discussed contemporary literature, she did not rush to define it first. Instead, she asked students to compare how several writers describe cities, families, and the pressure on ordinary people.
People who study how contemporary people go out have found that when bags are made a bit simpler, they actually become easier for everyone to use.

glosses.notes: A formal word for the present day or the world today, often used in broader discussion or analysis.

examples.sentence: 在当今的求职环境里，很多公司看重的已经不只是学历高不高，还要看一个人能不能长期和别人合作。
那位校长谈到当今年轻人的读书习惯时，没有只怪手机，而是先问学校给的东西够不够好。
纪录片里提到，当今不少城市最难解决的不是修更多路，而是怎样让老人、孩子和上班族都出行得更安心。

example_translations.translation: In today's job market, many companies care not only about how high someone's education level is, but also about whether that person can cooperate with others over the long term.
When that principal talked about the reading habits of young people today, he did not just blame phones, but first asked whether what the school provided was good enough.
The documentary mentioned that in the present day, the hardest problem for many cities is not building more roads, but making travel feel safer for the elderly, children, and working people alike.

glosses.notes: Directly in front of someone, rather than through messages, calls, or other people.

examples.sentence: 这件事如果只靠消息转来转去，很容易越说越乱，你最好还是找他当面谈一次，把误会和要求都说明白。
她收到投诉以后没有急着在电话里解释，而是请对方第二天来店里当面看记录，结果很多疑问一下就解开了。
那位老教师退休前总坚持，表扬学生最好当面说，因为真正被看见的感觉，会比写在纸上更有力量。

example_translations.translation: If this matter is handled only by passing messages back and forth, it can easily get more and more confused. You should really talk to him face to face once and explain both the misunderstanding and the request clearly.

After receiving the complaint, she did not rush to explain things over the phone. Instead, she asked the other person to come to the shop the next day and look at the records in person, and many doubts were cleared up at once.
Before retiring, that older teacher always insisted that praise should be given face to face, because the feeling of truly being seen carries more power than words written on paper.

glosses.notes: The present moment or the current situation right now, often in contrast with the future or with abstract plans.

examples.sentence: 面对当下的变化，这家公司没有急着往外走，而是先把老客人要什么重新想了一遍。
他坐在海边等消息的时候，突然明白自己一直在想未来，却很少看当下的天和海。
老师提醒大家，讨论理想当然重要，但也别忽略当下最该完成的任务，不然计划写得再漂亮也走不远。

example_translations.translation: Facing the changes of the current moment, this company did not rush outward. Instead, it first thought through again what its older customers wanted.
While sitting by the sea waiting for news, he suddenly realized that he had always been thinking about the future, yet rarely looked at the sky and sea of the present moment.

The teacher reminded everyone that discussing ideals is certainly important, but they should not ignore the tasks that most need to be completed right now, otherwise even the best-written plans will not take them far.

glosses.notes: To win a vote and be chosen for a position or office.

examples.sentence: 她刚当选以后，第一件事不是高兴，而是把答应大家的小事都先写下来。
那位市长当选以后接受采访时说，比起掌声，他更在意大家愿不愿意继续监督自己把承诺做完。
新负责人虽然当选了，但是会议一结束就留下来听大家说话，因为他知道后面才是真正的考验。

example_translations.translation: Right after being elected, the first thing she did was not celebrate, but write down the small things she had promised everyone.
After being elected, the mayor said in an interview that compared with applause, he cared more about whether everyone was willing to keep supervising him until he fulfilled his promises.
Although the new person in charge was elected, he stayed behind to listen to everyone as soon as the meeting ended, because he knew the real test would come afterward.

glosses.notes: An organized file or archived record kept so information can be checked later.

examples.sentence: 办公室要搬走以前，大家先把多年的档案按年份放好，免得以后找东西太麻烦。
研究的人在旧档案里找到一张老地图，所以文章最后的结论也改了。
学校提醒毕业生走以前把个人档案再看一遍，不然以后发现错了再改会更麻烦。

example_translations.translation: Before the office moved away, everyone first put years of files in order by year, so that finding things later would not be too troublesome.
Someone doing the research found an old map in the archived files, so the final conclusion of the article changed as well.
The school reminded graduating students to look through their personal file once before leaving, otherwise finding an error later and changing it would be even more troublesome.

glosses.notes: That very day, not later or on another date.

examples.sentence: 因为怕天气突然变，大家要求所有工作人员在活动当天早点到，把设备再看一遍。
她原本只想去办一张新卡，没想到当天系统恢复得很快，连之前一直排着的几件事也顺手都处理完了。
会议通知写得很清楚，外地来的人如果不能在当天赶回去，可以先在服务台登记，再统一安排晚上的车。

example_translations.translation: Because they were afraid the weather might suddenly change, everyone asked all staff to arrive early on the day of the event and check the equipment once more.
She had only planned to get a new card, but unexpectedly the system recovered very quickly that same day, and she ended up taking care of several other matters that had been waiting as well.

The meeting notice was very clear: if people coming from out of town could not get back that very day, they could first register at the service desk and then have evening transportation arranged together.
